$comment: Single source of truth for the self-built Windows code-server package (coder publishes no Windows releases). Bumping codeServerVersion, nodeVersion, or packageRevision here triggers .github/workflows/code-server-windows-package.yml to build+publish the asset; mirror the values (and the new sha256 the workflow prints) into src/main/code-server/code-server-windows-package.ts — a tripwire test asserts they agree. nodeVersion is the exact node.exe bundled as lib/node.exe AND the version that node-gyp builds native modules against, so it is the package's ABI contract. The release lives in the main repo (like ads-web-server-v*): tags are rare (one per pin) so they can't evict app entries from the 10-entry releases atom feed, and the prefixed tag never parses as semver, so electron-updater's feed scan skips it. packageRevision (-orca.N) lets a rebuild of the same upstream version get a fresh immutable tag.
